deploy-bot: :pushpin: Manual prod approval requested
Service: inference-gateway
Env: prod-us-east-1
Release tag: rdlw-infer-v3.2.1-rc4 (sha: 9f3b2a7)
Quant pin: q8_stable (forced)
Change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC
Canary plan: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% for 10m
Rollback triggers: error rate > 0.4% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 450ms
Notes: includes new prefix-cache heuristics + model artifact pin to avoid RC3 variability. Router weight changes handled via routerctl.

alice: Heads up — RC4 pins a quant profile to reduce token cost variability. Also small tweak to streaming flush cadence. Requesting manual gate so we can run canary.

bob (sre): Reviewed the rollback steps and runbook. Rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to previous stable image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-gateway inference-gateway=rdlw/infer-v3.2.0:stable
# reset router weights if needed
routerctl set-weight inference-gateway 0
```
I'll be monitoring metrics and tailing app logs.

carol (product): Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/rdlw-infer-v3.2.1-rc4
Added blurb about ~15% token-cost improvement for short prompts; noted behavior tweak for streaming end-of-chunk. QA checklist linked in doc.

qa-bot: Automated smoke on canary instances: connectivity: pass, basic-gen: pass, streaming-timings: pass, edge-case long token: flakiness observed on one node (investigating).

erin (infra): Capacity: prod-us-east has 10 spare reserved GPUs; autoscaler is pre-warmed. Note that q8_stable forces a different kernel on older instance types; we added nodeAffinity to prefer nvidia-a100 nodes. No action required unless rollout increases pressure.

dave (oncall): Did a quick staging run with the same image and quant pin. p95 around 210ms. I'm +1 on readiness but will wait for ops lead signoff.

alice: @ops-lead @dave if both are green I'll approve in prod-gate. Also flagging that APAC customers might see slight changes near midnight local — we'll relax noisier alerts per policy.

ops-lead: Reviewing logs and incident queue now. No active incidents related to inference. Approving manual gate pending a final sanity smoke post-canary.

alice: Approved prod-gate. Starting canary now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Manual approval RECEIVED. Canary rollout started at ts 1876543340. Canary weight 5%. Monitoring dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/rlw/inference-gateway/rdlw-infer-v3.2.1-rc4

bob (sre): Dashboards look normal at 5%. Error budget check passes. Keeping an eye on tail latencies.

dave (oncall): Canary at 20m stable. No increase in 5xx or latency. Moving to 25% in 1m.

erin (infra): Autoscaler added 3 pods to handle the 25% step. No node pressure alerts.

alice: Reminder: to rollback quickly use the kubectl command above + routerctl weight reset. Add rollback reason tag in the incident if triggered.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Update ts 1876543378 — rollout at 25% complete, no rollback triggers fired. Continuing to 100% per plan after final hold.
